note: Bluestone State Park's rustic campground on the Bluestone River arm of Bluestone Lake near Hinton, with a central bathhouse; the park says it is not suited to larger RVs. Meador Campground (hookups) is the park's other drive-in campground. --Claude
summary: Park page still says Old Mill is closed for the Bluestone Dam construction, reopening when it is completed (no date): status confirmed manual with the banner quoted. Confirmed 33 rustic sites and the 14-night maximum. Season 'spring through fall, weather permitting' (no dates, left inherited). Not stated: rates, hookups explicitly (left derived 0), booking (the booking site sells only Bluestone's picnic shelters). Note trimmed of the site count/hookups/closure the fields now carry.
flags: Temporary closure re-confirmed 2026-10-21 from the park page: 'Old Mill is currently closed due to construction at Bluestone Dam and will reopen once construction is completed' (East Shore too); no reopening date, so re-check later.
The park says Old Mill 'is not suggested for larger RVs and campers' with no posted length; a 23-ft motorhome is probably fine, but no length is given to confirm it.
